title: Smiling Young Girl by Garden Bushes, 1950s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century black-and-white snapshot showing a young smiling girl seated on the grass in front of dense garden foliage and a siding-paneled house. She is dressed in a dark patterned dress with a white Peter Pan collar, with her hair styled neatly with ribbons or bows on each side. The print features classic deckled/scalloped edges characteristic of amateur family photography in post-World War II America.
